second_reading_overturned.why: Triangle-sourced and cohort-enforced, so under the clarification the check is the printed gross table and the stated movement of unstated basis is not. The row lengths and the 'Estimate total losses' row fix the columns: 2012-2017, with '2011 & Prior' printing only a total (21,744) and no development. The table matches the stored grid in every cell. Over underwriting years up to 2015: 2012 -9; 2013 +5; 2014 -22; 2015 +117; total +91, equal to the adopted +91.0. Correct, overturning the first reader's undeterminable, which turned on the stated figure. Recorded, as clause 3 requires: note 5's 'unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' deterioration) of $121m' (basis not stated, accident-year) differs by 30.

Stated-sourced (empty route; both models read note 19 and the sign veto kept their figure). Cohort-disclosed. Unlike 2010/2019 the rows are not transposed: the current-year line (95,047) matches the 2023 underwriting year's first estimate (95,720), and the 2022 comparative matches the same way (236,186 against 235,533). The prior-year line therefore covers every earlier underwriting year including 2022, year t-1, which refinement 2 allows a disclosed figure; it excludes the current year and is a prior-year movement. The adopted 15.992 is the line's gross 15,992. Correct, overturning the first reader's scope error under refinement 2. Recorded, as refinement 2 requires: year t-1 dominates the line. The 2022 year moved 280,185 - 235,533 = +44,652 during 2023, and the triangle over underwriting years up to 2021 gives a release of 26,439 (2014 -225; 2015 -1,474; 2016 +64; 2017 -2,512; 2018 -4,756; 2019 -2,647; 2020 -3,933; 2021 -10,956).

Triangle-sourced and cohort-enforced. The provision row has eleven values (Before 2011 = 9.5) and the development rows ten, so the development columns are 2011-2020 and 'Before 2011' has none. Over underwriting years up to 2018: 2011 188.6-188.6 = 0.0; 2012 -0.6; 2013 -1.0; 2014 -0.1; 2015 -3.3; 2016 -2.1; 2017 +0.3; 2018 +50.7; total +43.9, equal to the adopted +43.9. Correct, overturning the first reader's undeterminable, which turned on note 3's GBP2.9m of unstated basis (recorded under clause 3). Recorded: the stored grid bound the 'Before 2011' header to 2011 and lost the real 2011 column, whose step is 0.0, so the figure is unaffected here; and the stored triangle's currency label reads USD although the table is in sterling. The 2018 step is 12-to-24-month development, which the filing says includes earning.

Stated-sourced: the sign veto overruled the route's triangle (-51.115) and the provisions note's figure was adopted (R197 register; refinement 1), so rule 2 applies. Cohort-disclosed, so under refinement 2 the prior-year line may include year t-1. The adopted 136.6 is the note's gross 136,644 to one decimal (difference 0.044, tolerance 6.830); the line is a change in estimates of prior-year provisions in the Gross column, and the current year is its own line. Correct. Recorded with the record, as refinement 2 requires: the first reader found that year t-1 dominates the line (the 2023 underwriting year's gross estimate rose 152,494 during 2024 on p55, more than the whole line), and the overruled mature-year triangle gives a release of 51.115m.
